entities.summary: John Shoffner is an American racing driver, investor, and pilot. He was an astronaut crew member on Axiom Mission 2, the second entirely-private crew mission to the International Space Station. Shoffner served as the pilot of the Crew Dragon crew vehicle, which launched on May 21, 2023.
